notes.title: Finally - Version 1.0.0 - Full Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44032745/40edece22423328fbc78b550fb3b8402256492e0.jpg

We finally made it! Sorry about the lack of regular updates - though I have worked feverishly on the game, updates aren't my strong point, but here we are! 

There is now a new level, the Arctic, and a new boss fight. Enjoy!

I have added different difficulty levels for those who found the game too hard or who would like a special challenge. 

Let me know what you think. Feedback is very rare for game devs to get, but very precious. Email me here.. 

Thank you! 

One of the best things any of us can do for indie game devs these days is to buy their game, usually at the price of a cup of coffee.

Thanks again!

notes.title: 0.5.17 - Singularity Blade Update
notes.notes: Added a new power, singularity blade. You can purchase it to be available from the beginning or chest will have it as a spawn option in the Charred Lands. Also implemented other minor gameplay mods and bug fixes.

notes.title: New Training Level Added (Patch 0.5.9)
notes.notes: I got some great feedback from a player (who also happens to be a game dev) last week saying that the desert level was too hard in the beginning. I considered lowering the desert difficulty but instead added a much easier training level. As I've said, I'm very interested in player feedback and will often act on it. Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 0.5.8
notes.notes: Increased chest drop rate in the desert.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.7
notes.notes: I know that today was only the first day of Cy's early access on Steam but I found a few minor things I wanted to go ahead and fix. One was some of the text staying on the start screen after resetting and another was making sure all playthroughs are counted on both levels as it affects a few things in game.
